claims.claim_text: The indexed Henry M Paechter is linked at high confidence to historian Henry M. Pachter, born Heinz Maximilian Paechter.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Henry M. Pachter was born Heinz Maximilian Paechter
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The institutional finding aid supplies the exact birth name and states that Pachter worked for the OSS in the early 1940s.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact original surname, matching given name and middle initial, and explicit OSS association in an authoritative archival finding aid.
claims.temporal_assessment: The finding aid places his OWI and OSS work in 1941-1945 but does not order the overlapping appointments precisely.
claims.match_notes: Henry M. Pachter and Heinz Maximilian Paechter are published as documented variants; the index spelling remains primary source wording.

claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar work, but not the immediate pre-OSS affiliation because exile and later wartime work intervened.
claims.match_notes: Modeled as self-employment because no employing organization is named; not marked immediate or last civilian employment.
